items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: Let Raymond do all that slides up on that drum.

ctx.x: You know, we had big shows. About 12 girls, and comedians, dancers. They had the whole thing. In fact, that's when Tip, Tap, and Toe first got that drum to dance on because that -- there was a dancer up there, he used to dance with a spear. Norton Naughton and Margo was a dance team, a guy and a girl. And they used to do some real nice fancy dances, you know. And they used to use that drum.

And so, they had an idea, Andy Razaf and them, for Tip, Tap, and Toe to use that drum. Let Raymond do all that slides up on that drum. And that's when they first got that drum to dance on was at -- in the Grand Terrace show.
